summary: HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered...
description:
HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered session ids in HTTP::Session::Store::CHI.

The session id from the client's cookie reaches the CHI cache unchanged. The sibling HTTP::Session::Store::Memcached rejects ids that contain control characters, but the CHI store has no such check, and CHI does not escape keys for its memcached drivers.

With a memcached driver, a CR and LF in the session id end the cache command early, and the server reads the bytes after them as further commands.

summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization of...
description: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code by pushing a crafted serialized job onto the Redis-backed Laravel Horizon queue, which runs without authentication in affected deployments. Laravel's CallQueuedHandler unserializes the job without class restrictions, allowing attackers to instantiate the existing App\\Jobs\\TaskDownloadRun class and invoke an attacker-controlled Artisan command. Attackers can leverage the bundled laravel/tinker package to execute arbitrary PHP and operating system commands as the queue worker's user, write a persistent web shell into the web-served storage/app/public directory, and read database credentials, stored device credentials, and API tokens. Where Redis is not directly reachable, authenticated attackers can deliver the payload through the application by configuring a device target that points at the rConfig server's loopback address.

description: A flaw was found in GStreamer's gst-plugins-good, specifically in the H.264 RTP depayloader element. When processing MTAP16 or MTAP24 multi-time aggregation RTP packets, a signed/unsigned integer conversion error causes the remaining-length counter to underflow to a large positive value when the packet is truncated. This allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to trigger an out-of-bounds heap read of up to approximately 64 KiB of process memory by sending a single malformed RTP packet. Successful exploitation can crash the receiving GStreamer pipeline (denial of service), and in relay or transcoding deployments where output is accessible to the attacker, may expose adjacent heap contents.

summary: WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Unrestricted File Upload in the /panel/upload.php endpoint. Due to...
description:
WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Unrestricted File Upload in the /panel/upload.php endpoint. Due to a client-controlled permission check parameter and insufficient validation of the uploadPath parameter, an unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary files to any locations on the server, leading to Remote Code Execution.


This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

cwes.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

description:

Due to a client-controlled permission check parameter and insufficient validation of the currentpath parameter, an unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary files to any locations on the server, leading to Remote Code Execution.


This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

cwes.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

summary: WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Bruteforce Protection Bypass in the login functionality. The cookie...
description:
WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Bruteforce Protection Bypass in the login functionality. The cookie-based lockout can be bypassed by omitting the login_count and login_timeout cookies, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform an unlimited number of login attempts.




This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

cwes.name: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

summary: WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Reflected XSS in the /index.php endpoint. An attacker can prepare...
description:
WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Reflected XSS in the /index.php endpoint. An attacker can prepare an URL that, when opened, results in arbitrary JavaScript execution in the victim's browser, allowing e.g session cookie theft.


This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

summary: Administrative roles and module permissions are stored in mutable local database fields, allowing...
description: Administrative roles and module permissions are stored in mutable local database fields, allowing privilege escalation for attackers with database write access.

summary: The application implements software update functionality without adequate authenticity and...
description: The application implements software update functionality without adequate authenticity and integrity validation, allowing update packages to be accepted without sufficient cryptographic verification.

summary: The JWT Auth WordPress plugin through 3.0.2 does not invalidate previously issued refresh tokens...
description: The JWT Auth WordPress plugin through 3.0.2 does not invalidate previously issued refresh tokens when a user changes or resets their password or removes a connected device, allowing an attacker who obtained a refresh token before such an event to keep issuing valid access tokens and retain authenticated access to the account, up to Administrator.

summary: The FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification WordPress plugin from 1.11.2 to 1.12.1 does not perform...
description: The FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification WordPress plugin from 1.11.2 to 1.12.1 does not perform authorisation or validity checks before marking a WooCommerce order's SMS verification as completed, allowing unauthenticated users to forge the verified state of an order and bypass the plugin's SMS verification control.

summary: The Confection WordPress Cable WordPress plugin from 0.4.0 to 0.4.7 does not perform any...
description: The Confection WordPress Cable WordPress plugin from 0.4.0 to 0.4.7 does not perform any capability or nonce checks before saving its settings and writing one of them, unmodified, into a standalone PHP file that it then serves, allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.

cwes.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code

summary: The WP Duplicate  WordPress plugin through 1.1.11 does not properly verify a request...
description: The WP Duplicate  WordPress plugin through 1.1.11 does not properly verify a request authentication value and does not validate the path or type of uploaded files, making it possible for unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files to the server and achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild.

cwes.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

summary: The GemBooking  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not properly verify that a REST request is...
description: The GemBooking  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not properly verify that a REST request is addressed to its own routes before temporarily granting staff users administrative capabilities, allowing users with the GemBooking  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1's Staff role to delete arbitrary posts and update the site's settings.

summary: The Advanced Appointment Booking & Scheduling WordPress plugin before 2.7 does not verify the...
description: The Advanced Appointment Booking & Scheduling WordPress plugin before 2.7 does not verify the site's user-registration setting before creating accounts through a publicly accessible shortcode, allowing unauthenticated attackers to register arbitrary user accounts, and be automatically logged in, even when user registration is disabled on the site.

summary: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not validate the...
description:
The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not validate the ticket-type price sent to one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions when the referenced product has no ticket types configured, and stores the submitted price site-wide, where it is applied to the next event ticket added to any cart, allowing unauthenticated visitors to buy event tickets at an arbitrary price, including for free.

This is due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-34898.

summary: The WooCommerce Stripe Payment Gateway WordPress plugin before 11.1.0 does not exclude the...
description: The WooCommerce Stripe Payment Gateway WordPress plugin before 11.1.0 does not exclude the account password from the checkout fields it saves to order metadata during express checkout, causing the password a customer chooses when creating an account at checkout to be stored in plaintext in the database, readable by anyone with access to order data or the database. Version 10.9.0 stored the passwords. Version 10.9.1 stopped new ones from being stored but left existing ones in place, and version 11.1.0 removes them on update. Passwords stored this way should be considered exposed.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: The GemBooking  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not serialise concurrent booking requests per...
description: The GemBooking  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not serialise concurrent booking requests per team member, allowing unauthenticated users to create overlapping confirmed bookings for the same team member across different bookable items by sending simultaneous requests.

cwes.name: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization

summary: The UniPAY Payment Gateway For WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.4 does not perform any...
description: The UniPAY Payment Gateway For WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.4 does not perform any authorization check before returning an order's order-received URL for an attacker-supplied order id, exposing the order's secret key in the redirect and allowing unauthenticated attackers to enumerate orders and disclose customers' personal data (name, email address, phone number and address).

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: The WP BASE Booking of Appointments, Services and Events WordPress plugin before 6.5.1 does not...
description: The WP BASE Booking of Appointments, Services and Events WordPress plugin before 6.5.1 does not properly restrict access to one of its user-creation actions, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access and above to create a new administrator account and thereby escalate their privileges.

summary: The Fusion Page Builder WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not check that the user owns the...
description: The Fusion Page Builder WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 does not check that the user owns the content it moves to the trash, which could allow users with a role as low as Contributor to trash arbitrary posts and pages, or delete them permanently where the trash is disabled.

summary: The Grand Job WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not correctly verify the password reset code...
description: The Grand Job WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not correctly verify the password reset code before updating a user's password, allowing unauthenticated attackers to set the password of arbitrary accounts, including administrators, and fully take over the site.
